title: Magnusim plugin manifest (manifest.toml)
description: A plugin's manifest.toml for host API 1.7. Generated by npm run gen:plugin-docs from python/cfddesk/registry/manifest.py; do not edit.

key.description: The plugin's id, the same as its folder name. Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

version.description: The plugin's own version; another plugin's requires_plugins compares it.

api_version.description: The host API the plugin is written for, major.minor. A host loads it only when the major version matches its own; a later minor version only adds things.

license.description: SPDX licence expression: GPL-3.0-or-later, or a licence compatible with it.

description.description: One sentence for the plugin's Settings row.

authors.description: A list of names, or one string of names separated by commas.

ui.description: The folder of the plugin's in-page panels (usually "ui"), or a table {dir, entry}. Leave it out when the plugin has none.

ui_entry.description: The entry file in the ui folder. A .tsx, .ts or .jsx entry is bundled by the host when served.

overrides.description: kind:key specs this plugin replaces (a list, or one string separated by commas).

requires.description: What the plugin needs on this PC (a WSL program, a Python package, a GPU); Settings shows what is missing.

tier.description: Informational: the folder decides the tier (bundled-plugins/ is bundled, plugins/ is user).

required.description: Bundled tier only: the app cannot create or run simulations without it, and it cannot be turned off.

default_enabled.description: Bundled tier only: false ships the plugin off until someone turns it on in Settings → Plugins.

requires_plugins.description: Plugins loaded before this one: "key" or "key>=1.0".

protected.description: Bundled tier only: kind:key specs of this plugin that other plugins may not drop.

study_name.description: The name a study gets when a project file stores none, one line.

default_analysis.description: A required bundled plugin only: the analysis a study gets when none is named (steady, its transient sibling, and the names older studies stored for it), and the name a study gets when none is stored.

workspaces.description: Full pages the plugin draws in a sandboxed frame.

start_actions.description: Buttons that create a study of a kind and open it in its workspace.

geometry_actions.description: Actions on a project geometry ("Edit in ..."): each opens a study of a kind that links geometry in its workspace, to edit that geometry and send the edit back.

max_file_mb.description: The largest file a workspace may write through ws.files, in MB.

max_total_mb.description: All the plugin's files in one project, in MB; at least max_file_mb.

files.description: Size limits for the plugin's own files in a project.

requirements.description: The lock file, every package pinned with == and hashed (pip --require-hashes).

service.description: The module magnusim_sdk.service runs as the plugin's backend, in its own environment.

find_links.description: A folder of wheels in the plugin, for installs with no network.

python.description: The plugin's own Python environment, built from its lock file, and its service.

title.description: Shown in the project tree and the menus.

icon.description: One SVG path (its d attribute) drawn in a 24×24 box.

workspace.description: The key of the [[workspaces]] page that opens a study of this kind.

schema_version.description: The version of this kind's study records; the service's migrate_study upgrades older ones.

links_geometry.description: A study of this kind may link one project geometry (needs a workspace; the call comes with 1.5).

title.description: The host's header shows it above the page.

icon.description: One SVG path (its d attribute) drawn in a 24×24 box.

entry.description: An .html file in the plugin's workspace/ folder, which is all the host serves.

study_kind.description: A [[study_kinds]] key with a workspace; one action per kind.

hint.description: A line under or beside the button.

icon.description: One SVG path; the kind's icon when left out.

places.description: Where the host draws it (default: all). A place this host does not know is left out with a warning.

home_label.description: Home's text for the button (default: label).

header_label.description: The header button's text (default: the workspace title); needs "header" in places.

study_kind.description: A [[study_kinds]] key with a workspace and links_geometry = true; one action per kind.

label.description: The menu item's and the button's text, one line.

hint.description: A line under the menu item and the button.

icon.description: One SVG path; the kind's icon when left out.

formats.description: The imports it edits (default: all). "mesh" and a format this host does not know are left out with a warning; a mesh import is never offered.

places.description: Where the host offers it (default: all): the tree's right-click menu, the viewport's right-click on the part, the Geometry panel. A place this host does not know is left out with a warning.
